cohort: The study included 3,863,594 singleton births in California from 2011 to 2020, occurring at or after 20 weeks of gestation, excluding those with hereditary anemias, out-of-hospital births, unlinked records, or missing variables.
finding: Antepartum anemia, most prevalent among Black pregnant patients, significantly contributed to disparities in severe maternal morbidity (SMM) by race and ethnicity, with nearly one in five to six SMM cases in several minority groups attributable to it.
